items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Whip
items.description: This long strand of thick leather, often braided, delivers a painful but nonlethal slash at a distance, usually accompanied by a distinctive cracking sound.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Shoddy Blunderbuss
items.description:
Activate 2

The blunderbuss fires an explosive shot that deals @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning],2d10[fire]|options:area-damage]{4d6 bludgeoning damage plus 2d10 fire damage} to all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Reflex Save|options:area-effect|showDC:owner] save).

When firing the blunderbuss, you must critically succeed at a @Check[crafting|dc:20|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Crafting] or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:20|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Engineering Lore|showDC:owner]{Engineering Lore} check or the weapon explodes, damaging you for the same amount as the creatures in the cone and destroying itself. A successful @Check[crafting|dc:22|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Reveal Unstable Nature|showDC:owner] check is enough to confirm the weapon's unstable nature if someone examines it beforehand.

Reloading the blunderbuss takes 3 Interact actions: adding 1 dose of gunpowder, adding 1 grapeshot canister, and packing the contents.

defensiveAbilities.name: Whiplash
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 10 feet of Gerhard uses an action with the move trait to leave a square.

Effect Gerhard attempts to Trip the triggering creature. On a success, the creature also takes damage as if Gerhard hit with his whip Strike, and if the creature was flying, it falls 30 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Manly Left Hook
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature struck by Gerhard's punch must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Stunned 1 (or Stunned 3 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Shoddy Blunderbuss
offensiveAbilities.description:
Gerhard fires an explosive shot from his blunderbuss that deals 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage|options:area-damage]{4d6 bludgeoning damage plus 2d10 fire damage} to all creatures in a 30ft Cone (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw).

When firing the blunderbuss, Gerhard must succeed at a Basic DC 20 Crafting or Engineering Lore check or the weapon explodes, damaging him for the same amount as the creatures in the cone and destroying itself. If someone other than Gerhard uses the weapon, they must critically succeed at the check. A successful Basic DC 22 Crafting check is enough to confirm the weapon's unstable nature if someone examines it beforehand.

Reloading the blunderbuss takes 3 Interact actions: adding 1 dose of gunpowder, adding 1 grapeshot canister, and packing the contents.

offensiveAbilities.name: Whip Swing
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement Gerhard is in a jungle, dense forest, or an area with numerous overhead beams.

Effect Gerhard uses his whip to lash upward to wrap around an overhanging tree branch; he then swings up to 30 feet in a straight line, and must end the movement on solid ground or fall.
